_comment: OTA manifest served from GitHub Pages and polled by the firmware's Settings > Update screen. Regenerated by .github/workflows/release.yml on every version tag, so it can never drift from TIGERSCALE_FW_VERSION. firmware_url must point at the plain firmware.bin, never firmware.factory.bin: Update.begin()/write() only replace the app partition, so a factory image would corrupt the bootloader and partition table. The binary published here is the esp32s3_hsu build.
